item.title: Six additional appointments including Kang Shin-sung, Jung Bong-ju, Song Ho-chang, and Han Sang-ik to Representative Kim Min-seok's special advisory team (與 김민석 특보단에 강신성·정봉주·송호창·한상익 등 6명 추가 인선)
item.description:
Six additional appointments including Kang Shin-sung, Jung Bong-ju, Song Ho-chang, and Han Sang-ik to Representative Kim Min-seok's special advisory team (與 김민석 특보단에 강신성·정봉주·송호창·한상익 등 6명 추가 인선)

On the 27th, Democratic Party of Korea Representative Kim Min-seok additionally appointed six special advisers by field, including former lawmaker Jung Bong-ju and attorney Song Ho-chang, to his party leader special advisory team. (더불어민주당 김민석 대표가 27일 당대표 특보단에 정봉주 전 의원과 송호창 변호사 등 분야별 특보 6명을 추가 임명했다.)

The Democratic Party announced that Representative Kim appointed special advisers in the fields of civic organizations, small and medium-sized enterprises, local autonomy, U.S. diplomacy, planning, and policy on that day to strengthen the party's expertise and on-the-ground presence. (민주당은 이날 김 대표가 당의 전문성과 현장성을 강화하기 위해 사회단체·중소기업·지방자치·대미외교·기획·정책 분야 특보를 각각 임명했다고 밝혔다.)

Kang Shin-sung, former vice president of the Korean Sport & Olympic Committee, was appointed as special adviser for civic organizations, and Kim Do-kyun, secretary general of the K-Leading Nation Future Forum, was appointed for the small and medium-sized enterprise sector. Park Wan-hee, former head of the National Association of Chairpersons of Basic Councils, was named special adviser for local autonomy. (사회단체 분야 특보에는 강신성 전 대한체육회 부회장, 중소기업 분야에는 김도균 K-선도국가미래포럼 사무총장이 임명됐다. 지방자치 분야 특보에는 박완희 전 전국기초의회의원협의회 대표가 이름을 올렸다.)

Song Ho-chang, partner attorney of the U.S. Policy Consulting Team at law firm Daeryuk Aju, was appointed special adviser for U.S. diplomacy, and former lawmaker Jung Bong-ju was appointed for planning. Han Sang-ik, former secretary for national agenda at the presidential office, will serve as special adviser for policy. (대미외교 분야 특보에는 송호창 법무법인 대륙아주 미국정책컨설팅팀 파트너변호사, 기획 분야에는 정봉주 전 국회의원이 각각 임명됐다. 정책 분야 특보는 한상익 전 대통령비서실 국정과제비서관이 맡는다.)

Earlier, Representative Kim appointed lawmaker Kim Kyo-heung and former Cheong Wa Dae senior presidential secretary for political affairs Choi Jae-sung as co-heads of the party leader special advisory team. (앞서 김 대표는 김교흥 의원과 최재성 전 청와대 정무수석을 당대표 특보단장으로 임명했다.)

The Democratic Party stated, "The newly appointed special advisory team will serve as a key communication channel that gathers diverse on-the-ground opinions and delivers them to the party." The advisory team plans to also form an online special advisory group in the future to collect broad input. (민주당은 “이번에 임명된 당대표 특보단은 다양한 현장의 의견을 수렴해 당에 전달하는 핵심 소통 창구 역할을 할 것”이라고 밝혔다. 특보단은 향후 광범위한 의견 수렴을 위한 온라인 특보단도 구성할 예정이다.)

item.title: Cho Hyun: "If Additional Rescue Teams Are Sent to Nepal, Dozens Must Go" (조현 “네팔에 구조대 추가로 보낸다면 수십명 가야”)
item.description:
Cho Hyun: "If Additional Rescue Teams Are Sent to Nepal, Dozens Must Go" (조현 “네팔에 구조대 추가로 보낸다면 수십명 가야”)

Foreign Minister Cho Hyun suggested that additional rescue teams could be sent to Nepal, where nine Koreans have gone missing due to massive flooding. (조현 외교부 장관은 대규모 홍수로 한국인 9명이 실종된 네팔 현지에 추가 구조대를 보낼 수 있다고 시사했다.)

Meeting with reporters on the 27th, Minister Cho said regarding the dispatch of rescue teams, "I need to speak with Nepal's foreign minister," and added, "If we send additional teams, dozens of people would need to go." (조 장관은 27일 취재진과 만나 구조대 파견 여부와 관련해 “네팔 외교 장관과 통화해야 한다”며 “(구조대를) 추가로 보낸다면 수십 명이 가야 한다”고 말했다.)

Minister Cho stated, "The rapid response team is a vanguard concept." He also noted that the nine Koreans out of contact and the ten isolated individuals were in different locations. The foreign ministry said the ten isolated individuals are in a safe situation awaiting rescue. (조 장관은 “신속대응팀은 선발대 개념”이라고 했다. 그러면서 한국인 중 연락이 두절된 9명과 고립된 10명은 각각 지대가 다른 곳에 있었다고 전했다. 고립된 10명은 구조를 기다리고 있는 안전한 상황인 것으로 파악됐다고 외교부가 밝혔다.)

The government dispatched an 11-member joint government rapid response team to Nepal that day, led by Lim Sang-woo, the foreign ministry's government representative for overseas citizens protection and consular affairs. (정부는 이날 임상우 외교부 재외국민보호·영사담당 정부대표를 팀장으로 하는 11명 규모의 정부합동 신속대응팀을 네팔에 파견했다.)

According to foreign media reports, flooding occurred in the Himalayan mountain region of north-central Nepal the previous day, leaving over 160 people dead and more than 820 missing. (외신 보도에 따르면 전날 네팔 중북부 히말라야 산악지대에서 홍수가 발생해 현재 160여 명이 숨지고 820여 명이 실종 상태다.)

The Koreans out of contact are three employees of Korea South-East Power Company, which was building a local hydroelectric power plant, and six employees of Doosan Enerbility. (연락이 끊긴 한국인은 현지 수력발전소를 건설하던 한국남동발전 소속 3명과 두산에너빌리티 소속 6명이다.)

The government is also checking for any additional damage to Korean nationals. The foreign ministry stated, "As around 20,000 Korean nationals typically visit Nepal annually for tourism purposes, we are continuously verifying whether there is any additional damage to our citizens." (정부는 우리 국민의 추가 피해 여부도 파악하고 있다. 외교부는 “통상 연 2만명 정도의 우리 국민이 관광 목적으로 네팔을 방문하고 있는 만큼, 우리 국민의 추가 피해가 있는지 계속 확인하고 있다”고 밝혔다.)

item.title: Chung Dong-young Claims North Korea's Nuclear Capability "Increased 100,000-Fold"... Controversy Over Exaggerated Figures (정동영 “北 핵능력 10만배 증대”... 수치 과장 논란)
item.description:
Chung Dong-young Claims North Korea's Nuclear Capability "Increased 100,000-Fold"... Controversy Over Exaggerated Figures (정동영 “北 핵능력 10만배 증대”... 수치 과장 논란)

Controversy over the factual accuracy has arisen after Unification Minister Chung Dong-young said on the 27th that North Korea's nuclear capability has "increased 100,000-fold over the past 30-plus years since 1992." (정동영 통일부 장관이 27일 북한 핵 능력이 “1992년 이래 30여 년 만에 10만배로 증대됐다”고 발언한 데 대해 사실관계를 둘러싼 논란이 일고 있다.)

During his opening address at the "2026 International Korea Forum" held at the Westin Josun Seoul hotel in central Seoul that day, Minister Chung said, "Thirty-four years ago, North Korea reported to the International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA) that it had extracted 90 grams of plutonium, but 34 years later, U.S. President Donald Trump recently said North Korea possesses 57 nuclear weapons." (정 장관은 이날 서울 중구 웨스틴조선 호텔 서울에서 열린 ‘2026 국제한반도포럼’ 개회사에서 “34년 전 북한이 국제원자력기구(IAEA)에 플루토늄 90g을 추출했다고 신고했지만 34년 후 최근 도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령이 북한에 핵무기 57개를 가졌다고 말했다”며 이렇게 말했다.)

Chung's claim that North Korea's nuclear capability has grown 100,000-fold over 30 years came amid his remarks that "North Korea's nuclear capability is growing even at this very moment" and that "it is clear that the previous approach centered on 'complete denuclearization' can no longer be sustained." In his speech that day, Minister Chung did not provide specific evidence for his assessment that North Korea's nuclear capability had increased 100,000-fold over three decades. (정 장관의 ‘30년간 북핵 능력 10만배 증대’ 주장은 “이 순간에도 북한의 핵 능력은 커지고 있다”며 “과거와 같은 ‘완전한 비핵화’를 앞세우는 접근은 더는 지속하기 어려운 현실이 분명하다”고 발언하는 과정에서 나온 것이다. 정 장관은 이날 연설에서 북핵 능력이 30여 년 만에 10만배로 증대됐다고 평가한 구체적 근거를 제시하지는 않았다.)

The amount of plutonium North Korea initially reported to the IAEA in 1992 was 90 grams (0.09 kg). Calculated based on plutonium extraction amounts, 100,000 times 90 grams amounts to 9 tons (9,000 kg). (북한이 1992년 IAEA에 최초 신고한 플루토늄 추출량은 90g(0.09㎏)이다. 플루토늄 추출량을 기준으로 계산하면 90g의 10만배는 9t(9000㎏)에 달한다.)

The amount of plutonium typically required to produce one nuclear warhead is estimated at 4-6 kg. The total plutonium needed to produce the 57 nuclear warheads mentioned by President Trump would be approximately 228-342 kg. This is roughly 2,500-3,800 times the 0.09 kg figure North Korea initially reported to the IAEA in 1992. (핵탄두 1개를 제작하는 데 필요한 플루토늄 양은 보통 4~6㎏으로 추산된다. 트럼프 대통령이 언급한 핵탄두 57개를 제작하는 데 필요한 플루토늄 총량은 약 228~342㎏ 정도다. 이는 북한이 1992년 IAEA에 최초로 신고한 수치인 0.09㎏ 대비 약 2500~3800배 수준이다.)

A Unification Ministry official said, "Rather than the number 100,000 being important, please understand it as an intention to emphasize that (North Korea's nuclear capability) has changed enormously compared to 30 years ago." (통일부 당국자는 “10만이라는 숫자가 중요하기보다는 (북핵 능력이 30년 전과) 차이가 많이 난다는 점을 강조하기 위한 취지로 이해해 달라”고 했다.)

Earlier, in March, Minister Chung caused a stir by publicly mentioning Kusong, North Pyongan Province, as the site of a third uranium enrichment facility during a National Assembly Foreign Affairs and Unification Committee session. The United States has not yet lifted restrictions on intelligence sharing regarding North Korea's nuclear activities since Chung publicly disclosed sensitive North Korea-related information. A former senior diplomatic and security official said, "While it is understood as a remark born of concern over North Korea's nuclear capability being advanced day by day, caution is needed in public statements involving specific figures or intelligence matters." (앞서 정 장관은 지난 3월 국회 외교통일위원회에서 북한의 제3의 우라늄 농축 시설로 평안북도 구성을 공개 언급해 파장을 일으켰다. 미국은 정 장관이 민감한 대북 정보를 공개 언급한 이후 아직까지 북핵 활동 관련 정보 제한 조치를 풀지 않고 있다. 전직 외교안보 고위 관료는 “북핵 능력이 나날이 고도화되는 상황을 우려한 발언으로 이해되지만 구체적 수치나 정보 사항은 발언에 신중을 기할 필요가 있다”고 했다.)

item.title: Lee Orders "Careful Attention to Families of Nepal Flood Victims"…Directs Designation of Dedicated Officials (李 “네팔 홍수 피해자 가족 세심히 챙겨야”…전담관 지정 지시)
item.description:
Lee Orders "Careful Attention to Families of Nepal Flood Victims"…Directs Designation of Dedicated Officials (李 “네팔 홍수 피해자 가족 세심히 챙겨야”…전담관 지정 지시)

President Lee Jae-myung on the 27th ordered the designation of dedicated officials to support the families of victims of the Nepal floods, as well as dedicated public affairs officers to continuously share updates on search and rescue operations. (이재명 대통령은 27일 네팔 홍수 피해자 가족들을 지원하기 위한 전담관과 수색 구조 상황을 지속적으로 공유하는 전담 공보 담당자를 지정하라고 지시했다.)

According to briefing by Senior Presidential Spokesperson Kang Yu-jung, President Lee held an emergency meeting at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs building that day to address the situation of Korean nationals affected by the Nepal floods, stating, "We must understand and carefully attend to the feelings and circumstances of the families who are waiting anxiously for news." (이 대통령은 이날 외교부 청사에서 네팔 홍수 관련 우리 국민 피해 상황 대응 긴급회의를 개최해 “애타는 마음으로 연락을 기다리고 있을 가족들의 마음과 상황을 잘 헤아려 세심하게 챙길 것”이라며 이같이 밝혔다고 강유정 청와대 수석대변인은 브리핑에서 전했다.)

President Lee said, "First, dispatch rescue personnel to the site as quickly as possible, and in consultation with the companies involved, carefully review requests from families, such as requests for meetings with families of employees who are isolated or out of contact," adding, "Designate a dedicated official to look after the families, and also designate a dedicated public affairs officer to continuously share the progress of search and rescue operations, so that the families feel no shortcoming in support." (이 대통령은 “우선 구조 인력을 최대한 신속하게 현지에 급파하고, 회사 측과 협의해 고립되거나 연락이 두절된 직원 가족들의 면담 요청 등 가족들의 요청 사항에 대해서도 잘 살펴보라”며 “가족들을 챙기는 전담관을 지정하고, 수색 구조를 비롯한 진행 상황을 지속적으로 공유할 전담 공보 담당자도 지정해 가족들이 부족함을 느끼지 않도록 세심히 대응하라”고 했다.)

President Lee further said, "With the resolve that there is no such thing as over-response when it comes to protecting the lives and safety of our people, mobilize all available resources and do our utmost," adding, "Work closely with the Nepalese government through all diplomatic channels to ensure that resources needed for search and rescue are deployed in a timely manner, and proactively review measures we can provide." He also extended condolences to the government and people of Nepal, adding, "Ensure that humanitarian support for early recovery and casualty response is provided without shortfall." (이 대통령은 또 “국민의 생명과 안전을 지키는 일에는 과잉 대응이 없다는 각오로 가용 자원을 총동원해 최선을 다해달라”며 “네팔 정부와 모든 외교 경로를 가동해 수색과 구조에 필요한 자원이 적시에 투입될 수 있도록 긴밀히 협의하고, 우리가 지원할 방안도 선제적으로 검토하라”고 했다. 이어 네팔 정부와 국민을 향한 위로를 전하며 “조기 복구와 인명 피해 수습을 위한 인도적 지원에 부족함이 없도록 챙기라”고 덧붙였다.)

President Lee postponed the scheduled senior secretary meeting to preside over the emergency review meeting in response to the situation, and also delayed the planned luncheon invitation for lawmakers of the Democratic Party of Korea that had been set for the 28th. <<>> (이 대통령은 이번 사태 대응을 위해 당초 예정됐던 수석보좌관 회의를 미루고 긴급 점검회의를 주재했으며, 오는 28일로 잡혔던 더불어민주당 국회의원 초청 오찬 일정 역시 연기했다.)

item.title: [Breaking] "9 of 10 Koreans Isolated by Nepal Floods Transported to Safe Area" ([속보] “네팔 홍수로 고립 한국인 10명 중 9명 안전지역 이송”)
item.description:
[Breaking] "9 of 10 Koreans Isolated by Nepal Floods Transported to Safe Area" ([속보] “네팔 홍수로 고립 한국인 10명 중 9명 안전지역 이송”)

The Ministry of Foreign Affairs announced on the 27th that "9 of the 10 people who were isolated and awaiting rescue due to the massive floods in Nepal have been transported to a safe area by Nepalese military helicopters." (외교부는 27일 “네팔 대홍수로 고립돼 구조를 기다리던 10명 중 9명이 네팔 군 헬기로 안전지역으로 이송됐다”고 밝혔다.)

The remaining person, a field site manager from Doosan Enerbility, stayed behind along with two embassy officials on the ground. (나머지 1명인 두산에너빌리티 소속 현장 소장은 현지에 대사관 직원 2명과 함께 잔류했다.)

These 10 people from Doosan Enerbility had been staying at a temporary shelter along with hundreds of foreigners and local residents.     (두산에너빌리티 소속 이들 10명은 다른 외국인과 현지인 등 수백명과 함께 임시대피소에 머물러왔다.    )

Earlier, a ministry official stated that their health conditions were good and that they were being provided with drinking water, food, and medical supplies.     (앞서 외교부 당국자는 이들의 건강 상태가 양호하며, 식수와 식량, 의료품 등을 제공받고 있다고 밝혔다.    )

Meanwhile, the whereabouts of 9 Koreans whose contact was lost due to the large-scale floods in Nepal the previous day have not yet been confirmed. (한편, 전날 네팔에서 일어난 대규모 홍수로 연락이 두절된 한국인 9명의 소재는 아직 확인되지 않고 있다.)

Foreign Minister Cho Tae-yul spoke by phone with Nepalese Foreign Minister Shishir Khadka that afternoon and requested support for the search and rescue of the 9 missing Korean nationals. (조현 외교부 장관은 이날 오후 시시르 커날 네팔 외교장관과 통화를 갖고 실종된 우리 국민 9명 수색·구조 지원을 요청했다.)

Minister Cho stated that to support the Nepalese government's swift response and early recovery efforts, "we will provide humanitarian aid worth $1 million through international organizations active in the region." (조 장관은 네팔 정부의 신속한 대응과 조기 복구 노력을 지원하기 위해 “현지에서 활동 중인 국제기구를 통해 100만달러 규모의 인도적 지원을 제공하겠다”고 했다.)

Minister Cho conveyed that at an emergency meeting chaired by Acting President Han Duck-soo, a directive was decided to mobilize all available means to make every effort in the search and rescue of the missing. He added, "We will also review and push forward the rapid dispatch of Korea's Disaster Relief Team." (조 장관은 이재명 대통령이 주재한 긴급회의에서 가용한 모든 수단을 동원해 실종자 수색 및 구조에 총력을 다한다는 지침이 결정됐다고 전했다. 그러면서 “대한민국 해외긴급구호대의 신속한 파견도 검토·추진해 나가겠다”고 했다.)

Minister Cho also requested active cooperation from the Nepalese government so that the joint government rapid response team, urgently dispatched to Nepal that day, could work closely with local authorities to ensure smooth search and rescue support activities for our nationals. (조 장관은 이날 네팔 현지로 급파한 정부합동 신속대응팀이 현지 당국과 긴밀히 협력하면서 우리 국민 수색과 구조 지원 활동이 원활하게 이루어질 수 있도록 네팔 정부 차원의 적극적인 협조도 당부했다.)

Minister Khadka explained the scale of damage and the response status of the floods in the Rasuwa region. The Ministry of Foreign Affairs said that Minister Cho expressed deep condolences to the Nepalese people affected by the floods and to the bereaved families. (커날 장관은 라수와 지역에서 발생한 홍수의 피해 규모와 대응 현황 등에 대해 설명했다. 조 장관은 홍수로 피해를 본 네팔 국민과 유가족에게 깊은 위로를 전했다고 외교부가 밝혔다.)

The two ministers agreed to continue close communication and cooperation between the two governments to address the flood damage in Nepal and to carry out the search and rescue of Korean nationals. (두 장관은 이번 네팔 홍수 피해 수습 및 우리 국민의 수색과 구조를 위해 양 정부 간 긴밀한 소통과 협력을 지속해 나가기로 했다.)

item.title: Park Geun-hye Attends People Power Party Retreat for First Time in 14 Years: "Internal Division Is the Most Fearsome Enemy" (14년만에 국힘 연찬회 온 박근혜 “내부 분열이 가장 무서운 적”)
item.description:
Park Geun-hye Attends People Power Party Retreat for First Time in 14 Years: "Internal Division Is the Most Fearsome Enemy" (14년만에 국힘 연찬회 온 박근혜 “내부 분열이 가장 무서운 적”)

Former President Park Geun-hye emphasized party unity and camaraderie at the People Power Party retreat on the 27th, stating, "When fighting against external enemies, there is no enemy more fearsome than our own internal division." She added, "If we pool our strength and make efforts, we could even become the majority party." (박근혜 전 대통령이 27일 국민의힘 연찬회에서 “밖의 적을 상대로 싸울 때 우리 내부의 분열만큼 무서운 적은 없다”며 당내 단결과 동지애를 강조했다. 그러면서 “힘을 모아 노력하면 다수당이 될 수도 있을 것”이라고 했다.)

Speaking at the party retreat held at a hotel in Goyang, Gyeonggi Province, the former President said, "When we are already outmatched against the majority, adding division to that would make the outcome of the fight all but certain." This marked Park's first attendance at a People Power Party retreat in 14 years, since her days as the Saenuri Party presidential candidate in 2012. (박 전 대통령은 이날 경기 고양시 한 호텔에서 열린 국민의힘 연찬회에 참석해 “다수를 상대로 힘에 부치는 상태에서 분열까지 하면 그 싸움은 보나마나 한 결과가 될 것”이라며 이같이 밝혔다. 박 전 대통령이 국민의힘 연찬회에 참석한 건 2012년 새누리당 대선 후보 시절 이후 14년 만이다.)

During her roughly 20-minute speech, Park urged trust and harmony. "I believe the most important thing in politics is trust," she said, citing the principle of "mushinbulip" (without trust, nothing can stand). "Without credibility, no organization can survive," she said. "Therefore, if there is no trust within a political party, that party cannot sustain itself." (박 전 대통령은 약 20분간 이어진 연설 동안 신뢰와 화합을 당부했다. 박 전 대통령은 “정치에 있어서 가장 중요한 것은 신뢰라고 생각한다”며 ‘무신불립(無信不立·신뢰 없이 설 수 없다)’을 언급했다. 그는 “신의가 없으면 어떤 조직도 존속할 수 없다”며 “따라서 정당 내에서 신의가 없으면 그 정당은 존립할 수가 없다”고 했다.)

She added, "While diverse opinions can emerge within a party, we must not hate or deny one another." Park said, "I hope this retreat will strengthen the camaraderie among you. In difficult times, we must unite as one around the leadership and move forward." (그러면서 “정당 내에서 다양한 의견이 나올 수 있지만 서로를 증오하거나 부정해서는 안 된다”고 했다. 박 전 대통령은 “이번 연찬회를 계기로 여러분의 동지애가 좀 더 두터워졌으면 한다”며 “어려운 때일수록 지도부를 중심으로 일치단결해서 나아가야 한다”고 했다.)

She continued, "The people must come before personal convictions. I ask the leadership and all of you (members of parliament) to come together as one through camaraderie and faithfully fulfill the roles each of you has been given." (이어 “개인의 소신보다는 국민이 먼저여야 한다”며 “지도부와 (국회의원) 여러분이 동지애로 하나로 뭉쳐 각자가 맡은 역할을 충실히 해 달라”고 당부했다.)

She also stressed the responsibility of the conservative party. "In times of crisis like this, the People Power Party, as the conservative party, must adopt a more responsible stance than the government and ruling party regarding national security," Park said. She added, "The economy is not about numbers but about embracing the lives of the people. Economic recovery that the people do not feel as improvement is not true recovery. It is the duty of a free right-wing party to prepare and implement feasible policies." (그는 보수 정당의 책임도 강조했다. 박 전 대통령은 “이런 위기 상황일수록 보수 정당인 국민의힘은 국가 안보에 있어 정부·여당보다 더 책임 있는 자세로 임해야 한다”고 했다. 이어 “경제는 숫자가 아니라 국민의 삶을 보듬는 것”이라며 “국민이 좋아졌다고 느끼지 못하는 경제 회복은 진정한 회복이 아니다. 실현 가능한 정책을 마련해 실천하는 것이 자유 우파 정당의 정의”라고 했다.)

item.title: Board of Audit and Inspection overturns 'statistics manipulation' findings on Moon administration... "The audit team at the time used coercion and fabrication" (감사원 ‘文정부 통계 조작’ 뒤집기... “당시 감사팀이 강압·조작”)
item.description:
Board of Audit and Inspection overturns 'statistics manipulation' findings on Moon administration... "The audit team at the time used coercion and fabrication" (감사원 ‘文정부 통계 조작’ 뒤집기... “당시 감사팀이 강압·조작”)

The Board of Audit and Inspection (BAI) on the 27th effectively overturned its own audit findings that the Moon Jae-in administration had manipulated and distorted statistics on housing, income, and employment over most of its five-year term. The BAI's "Task Force (TF) for follow-up measures to the special parliamentary investigation," which had been investigating the statistics manipulation audit team, announced that it had concluded the audit team coerced officials from the Moon administration's Blue House, the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport (MOLIT), and the Korea Real Estate Board (KREB) into making statements, fabricated what they said, and conducted illegal mobile phone forensics. It said it would impose heavy disciplinary measures—including dismissal, removal, demotion, and suspension—on 10 auditors from the statistics manipulation audit team. Nine of them were also referred to the police on charges such as abuse of authority. (감사원이 문재인 정부가 5년 임기 대부분 기간에 걸쳐 주택·소득·고용에 관한 통계를 조작·왜곡했다는 감사 결과를 27일 사실상 스스로 뒤집었다. 통계 조작 감사팀을 조사해 온 감사원 ‘국조특위 후속 조치 TF(태스크포스)’는 이날 통계 조작 감사팀이 문 정부 청와대와 국토교통부, 한국부동산원 관계자들을 강압해 진술을 강요하거나 진술한 내용을 조작했고, 휴대전화 포렌식도 위법하게 했다는 결론을 냈다고 발표했다. 통계 조작 감사팀 감사관 10명은 파면·해임·강등·정직 등 중징계하겠다고 했다. 이 가운데 9명은 경찰에 직권 남용 등의 혐의로 고발됐다.)

The BAI TF said it confirmed that the statistics manipulation audit team made coercive remarks during, before, or after the question-and-answer sessions in which they took statements from real estate statistics officials. These remarks reportedly included: "If you don't cooperate, your public service career is over" and "If things continue this way, KREB employees could be restructured." When they were dissatisfied with statements, they reportedly threw the interview records on the floor and intimidated the interviewees by saying, "This is not how you do it." (감사원 TF는 통계 조작 감사팀이 부동산 통계 관계자들로부터 진술을 받는 ‘문답’ 과정에서 또는 문답 전후에 이들을 압박하는 발언을 한 것으로 확인됐다고 밝혔다. “협조 안 하면 공직 생활이 끝난다” “이대로 가면 부동산원 직원들이 구조조정당할 수 있다” 등의 발언을 했다는 것이다. 진술 내용이 마음에 들지 않을 때는 문답서를 집어던지면서 “이렇게 하면 안 된다”고 겁박하기도 했다고 했다.)

Auditees are entitled to review their interview records and request corrections where they differ from what they originally said. However, the TF said the statistics manipulation audit team refused such corrections, and dressed up fabricated content as if it were the auditees' own statements to prepare and send case referral requests to the prosecution. (피감사자는 문답서를 열람하고 자신의 원래 발언과 다른 부분이 있으면 수정을 요구할 수 있다. 그러나 통계 조작 감사팀은 수정을 거부하고, 허위로 써넣은 내용을 피감사자의 진술인 것처럼 꾸며 수사 요청서를 만들어 검찰에 보냈다고 TF는 밝혔다.)

The TF concluded that the statistics manipulation audit team also pressured auditees into "emergency forensics"—which should only be conducted at the auditee's voluntary request when submitting their mobile phones—and then doctored documents to make it appear as if the auditees had voluntarily requested it. (TF는 통계 조작 감사팀이 피감사자가 자발적으로 휴대전화를 제출하면서 요청해야 할 수 있는 ‘긴급 포렌식’도 피감사자를 압박해 진행했고, 그러면서도 피감사자가 자발적으로 요청해서 한 것처럼 서류를 꾸몄다고 봤다.)

Based on the TF's findings, the BAI plans to re-deliberate and re-vote on the existing audit report. This means the contents of the audit report claiming the Moon administration manipulated statistics will be revised. A significant portion of what the TF concluded was obtained through coercion and fabrication is expected to be removed from the audit report. (감사원은 TF 결론을 바탕으로 기존 감사 보고서를 다시 심의·의결할 예정이다. 문 정부가 통계를 조작했다는 감사 보고서 내용이 바뀌는 것이다. TF가 강압·조작이었다고 결론 내린 내용 상당 부분은 감사 보고서에서 빠지게 될 것으로 전망된다.)

The BAI's reversal of its findings is also expected to affect the trials related to the statistics manipulation case. The prosecution received evidence collected by the BAI and used it to further investigate and indict those suspected of statistics manipulation, with first-instance trials currently underway. Since the BAI now claims that a large portion of the evidence it collected was "contaminated" through coercion, fabrication, and procedural violations, related evidence could be invalidated in court. (감사원의 결론 뒤집기는 통계 조작 사건 재판에도 영향을 미칠 것으로 보인다. 검찰은 감사원이 수집한 증거를 넘겨받고 이를 바탕으로 통계 조작 혐의자들을 추가로 수사·기소해 1심 재판이 진행 중인데, 감사원이 수집한 증거 상당수가 강압과 조작, 절차 위반으로 ‘오염’됐다고 주장함에 따라, 관련 증거들이 법정에서 무효화될 수 있다.)

A TF official said, "Among the evidence collected in the statistics manipulation audit, the key point was that senior Blue House and MOLIT officials pressured MOLIT working-level staff and KREB employees, leading to the so-called 'statistics manipulation,' but we believe the evidence supporting this is all contaminated." Regarding the physical evidence obtained through mobile phone forensics by the statistics manipulation audit team, the official added, "It is illegally obtained evidence. What remains in the end is only a very small portion." (TF 관계자는 “통계 조작 감사에서 수집된 증거 가운데 중요한 것이 청와대와 국토부 고위 관계자들이 국토부 실무자와 부동산원 직원들을 압박해서 이른바 ‘통계 조작’이 일어났다는 것인데, 이를 뒷받침하는 증거들은 다 오염돼 있다고 본다”고 했다. 통계 조작 감사팀이 휴대전화 포렌식으로 확보한 물증들에 대해서도 “위법 수집 증거”라며 “결과적으로 남는 증거는 아주 일부분”이라고 했다.)

The auditors who face heavy disciplinary action rebutted, saying, "We did not conduct coercive investigations or force statements." They said, "Through objective materials—such as KakaoTalk messages of officials from the Blue House, MOLIT, and KREB, internal work communications, and records of sample price revisions in the computer system—the audit team specifically confirmed the process by which demands from the Blue House and MOLIT led to actual downward adjustments of (house price growth rate) statistics." (중징계를 받게 된 감사관들은 “강압 조사를 하거나 진술을 강요한 사실이 없다”고 반박했다. 이들은 “감사팀은 청와대와 국토부, 부동산원 등 관계자들의 카카오톡 메시지, 내부 업무 연락, 전산 시스템상 표본 가격 수정 기록 등 객관적 자료를 통해, 청와대와 국토부의 요구가 실제 (집값 상승률) 통계 하향 조정으로 이어진 과정을 구체적으로 확인했다”고 했다.)

The auditors also pointed out that claims of coercive investigation emerged belatedly. They said, "Even during the prosecution's investigation following the BAI audit, the individuals involved testified that they had pressured KREB in accordance with instructions and demands from senior officials at the Blue House and MOLIT." They added, "If claims of coercive audit raised years later are accepted without verification, then in the future, even if auditees personally reviewed and signed and sealed their interview records, years later, merely claiming en masse by many officials that they were coerced could effectively invalidate the evidence from that time." (감사관들은 강압 조사를 당했다는 주장이 뒤늦게 나왔다는 점도 지적했다. 이들은 “관련자들은 감사원 조사 이후 검찰 수사 과정에서도 청와대와 국토부 상급자의 지시·요구에 따라 부동산원을 압박했다는 취지로 진술했다”고 했다. 또 “수년이 지난 뒤 제기된 강압 감사 주장이 검증 없이 그대로 받아들여진다면, 앞으로는 (피감사자가) 문답서 내용을 직접 확인하고 자필로 서명·날인했더라도 수년이 지난 뒤 다수 관계자가 일제히 강압 조사를 받았다고 주장하는 것만으로 당시 증거들이 사실상 부정되는 결과가 발생할 수 있다”고 했다.)

The BAI TF's conclusions largely accept the claims of "coercive and fabricated audits" raised by the Democratic Party of Korea (DPK) regarding the statistics manipulation audit. From March to May of last year, the DPK conducted a parliamentary investigation into the "alleged politically motivated prosecutorial indictment scandal," and included the BAI's audit targeting the Moon administration during the Yoon Suk Yeol administration as part of the scope of that "truth-finding" investigation. (감사원 TF의 결론은 더불어민주당이 통계 조작 감사와 관련해 제기한 ‘강압·조작 감사’ 주장을 대부분 받아들인 것이다. 민주당은 지난 3~5월 국회에서 ‘정치 검찰 조작 기소 의혹 사건 진상 규명’ 국정조사를 했고, 여기에 감사원이 윤석열 정부 때 문재인 정부를 겨냥해 한 감사를 ‘진상 규명’ 대상으로 포함시켰다.)

After the Lee Jae-myung administration took office, the BAI formed an approximately 40-member "Management Reform TF" in September of last year to investigate auditors who had carried out seven audits—including the statistics manipulation audit—that the DPK had flagged as "political audits." The statistics manipulation audit team was investigated at that time, and the TF at the time conducted a full review of 23,677 pages of documentary evidence, about 1,000 minutes of audio recordings, and more than 5,100 minutes of video recordings from the auditors' question-and-answer sessions with Blue House, MOLIT, and KREB officials, and found no evidence of coercion or fabrication. However, in April of this year, while the DPK's parliamentary investigation was underway, the current TF was formed to re-investigate, and statements and evidence matching the DPK's claims emerged. (감사원은 이재명 정부 출범 후인 지난해 9월 40여 명 규모의 ‘운영 쇄신 TF’를 구성해, 통계 조작을 비롯해 민주당이 ‘정치 감사’라고 문제 삼았던 감사 7건을 수행한 감사관들을 조사했다. 통계 조작 감사팀도 이때 조사를 받았고, 당시 TF는 증거 서류 2만3677쪽과 녹음 파일 1000여 분, 감사관들이 청와대·국토부·부동산원 관계자들을 문답 조사할 때 녹화한 영상 5100여 분 등을 전수 조사하고도 강압·조작은 드러나지 않았다고 했다. 하지만 민주당의 국정조사가 진행 중이던 지난 4월 이번 TF를 만들어 재조사에 나섰고, 민주당 주장에 맞는 진술과 증거들이 나왔다고 했다.)

The TF also said it found problems—such as coercive investigation and illegal forensics—in the audit concerning the "suspected cover-up and distortion of the killing of a South Korean fisheries official in the West Sea during the Moon administration." However, it did not discipline the audit team from that case, citing that the statute of limitations for disciplinary action had expired. (TF는 ‘문재인 정부의 서해 공무원 피살 사건 은폐·왜곡 의혹’ 감사에서도 강압 조사나 위법한 포렌식 등의 문제점이 발견됐다고 했다. 다만 당시 감사팀에 대해서는 징계 시효가 지났다며 징계하지 않았다.)

item.title: Kim Min-seok "Jung Cheong-rae's 'Unity' Differs from My View" Jung Cheong-rae "I Regret This" (김민석 “정청래 ‘단결’ 나와 생각 달라” 정청래 “유감”)
item.description:
Kim Min-seok "Jung Cheong-rae's 'Unity' Differs from My View" Jung Cheong-rae "I Regret This" (김민석 “정청래 ‘단결’ 나와 생각 달라” 정청래 “유감”)

Kim Min-seok, leader of the Democratic Party of Korea, said on the 27th during a speech at the party's workshop ahead of the regular parliamentary session that what is needed is not the "internal unity" stance of lawmaker Jung Cheong-rae, his rival in the party leadership race, but an expansion of the party's base. In response, party leader Jung said in a Facebook post, "I express regret over being named directly and used as a tool to advance Representative Kim's own argument." Even after the new leadership took office following the Democratic Party's August 17 national convention, aftershocks of factional strife within the ruling bloc appear to be continuing. <<> At the workshop held that afternoon at the Inspire Hotel in Yeongjong, Incheon, to prepare for the regular parliamentary session, Representative Kim said, "Lawmaker Jung believes 'there is no center.' This is his own claim, and it's not a matter of right or wrong or evaluation." He added, "He sees it as there being no center, only a swinging swing vote." <<> He said he had met with lawmaker Jung the previous day and had a conversation, adding, "Lawmaker Jung takes the position that unity ultimately leads to victory." He continued, "In contrast, President Lee and I share similar views. We believe that our traditional support base needs expansion toward the moderate right, and that after the insurrection, such expansion is inevitable." <<> Prior to his remarks, Representative Kim had also presented appreciation plaques to the previous leadership, including lawmaker Jung. Representative Kim said, "I will speak frankly and honestly about the 'ABC theory' (put forward by author Yoo)" and "The ABC theory was based on a paradigm of separating values from interests. It was a so-called 'value-interest separation theory,' suggesting some groups within us are value-driven while others are interest-driven. I don't think that holds much merit." <<> He then proposed his own new ABC theory. Instead of the existing ABC theory centered on ideology and values, he argued for an ABC theory focused on Affordability (people's livelihoods and pragmatism), Broadening (expansion), and Competence. <<> <<> Shortly after Representative Kim's remarks, former leader Jung posted on Facebook, saying, "Regarding the so-called centrist theory, my conversation with Representative Kim Min-seok was only a brief 1-2 minute exchange in the assembly hall yesterday." He added, "I truly never imagined that yesterday's brief chat would become material for today's presentation. I was taken aback and embarrassed." He further stated, "Cutting off the context at both ends, listening only to what he wanted to hear, and unilaterally asserting his claims by naming his rival from the party convention by real name—this is almost violent." (김민석 더불어민주당 대표는 27일 민주당 정기국회대비 워크숍 연설에서 당 대표 선거에서 경쟁했던 정청래 의원의 ‘내부 단결’ 기조가 아닌 외연 확장이 필요하다고 발언했다. 그러자 정 대표는 페이스북 글에서 “실명을 거론하며 김 대표 자신의 논리 전개의 도구로 사용한 것에 유감을 표한다”고 했다. 민주당 8·17 전당대회로 새 지도부가 들어선 뒤에도 여권 내 게파 갈등의 여진이 계속되는 모양새다.)

item.title: Audit Board Moves to Quash Statistics Manipulation Findings Under Moon Government... "Coercive Audits Under Previous Administration" (文정부 통계조작 무마하나… 감사원 “前정부서 강압 감사”)
item.description:
Audit Board Moves to Quash Statistics Manipulation Findings Under Moon Government... "Coercive Audits Under Previous Administration" (文정부 통계조작 무마하나… 감사원 “前정부서 강압 감사”)

The Board of Audit and Inspection effectively reversed its own previous audit findings on Monday, which had concluded that statistics were manipulated and distorted during the Moon Jae-in administration. The board's "Special Committee Follow-up Task Force (TF)," which has been investigating the statistics manipulation audit team, announced that it found coercive statements had been made to officials from the Moon administration's Blue House, the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport, and the Korea Real Estate Board during the audit process, and that mobile phone forensics were also conducted unlawfully. The board has called for severe disciplinary action—including dismissal, removal, demotion, or suspension—against 10 working-level members of the audit team, and has referred nine of them to the police on charges including abuse of authority. <<> In September 2023, the Board of Audit and Inspection had released audit findings stating that the Moon administration had manipulated and distorted statistics on housing, income, and employment across most of its five-year term. However, after the Lee Jae-myung administration took office last year and the Democratic Party repeatedly claimed the audit was itself "fabricated," the board formed a task force to investigate the audit team. <<> The board's TF stated that the audit team made pressure-laden remarks during or around the question-and-answer sessions with real estate statistics officials, such as "If you don't cooperate, your public service career is over" and "If this continues, Korea Real Estate Board employees could face restructuring." It also said the team refused requests from auditees to correct portions of the statements that differed from what they had actually said, and that fabricated content was dressed up as auditee testimony in investigation referral requests sent to prosecutors. The TF further found that "emergency forensics"—which should only be conducted when an auditee voluntarily submits their phone and requests it—were carried out under duress, with documents falsified to make it appear the requests had been voluntary. <<> The auditors facing severe discipline have pushed back, saying, "We did not conduct coercive investigations or force anyone to make statements." They also said, "Through objective evidence—including KakaoTalk messages, internal work communications, and records of sample price modifications in computer systems from the Blue House, the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport, and the Korea Real Estate Board—the audit team specifically confirmed the process by which the Blue House and the ministry's demands actually led to downward adjustments in (housing price increase) statistics." <<> Nevertheless, based on the TF's conclusions, the board plans to re-deliberate and re-adjudicate its previous audit report concluding that the Moon government manipulated statistics. This could also influence the ongoing first-instance trial in which prosecutors, relying on evidence collected by the board, have investigated and indicted those accused of statistics manipulation. (감사원이 문재인 정부 시절 통계 조작·왜곡이 있었다는 과거 감사 결과를 27일 사실상 스스로 뒤집었다. 통계 조작 감사팀을 조사해 온 감사원 ‘국조특위 후속 조치 TF(태스크포스)’는 감사 과정에서 문재인 정부 청와대와 국토교통부, 한국부동산원 관계자들에 대한 진술 강요 등이 있었고 휴대전화 포렌식도 위법하게 이뤄졌다는 결론을 냈다고 발표했다. 감사원은 당시 감사팀 실무자 10명에 대해 파면·해임·강등·정직 등 중징계를 요구하고, 그 중 9명은 직권 남용 등 혐의로 경찰에 고발했다.)

item.title: Lee Meets Heads of Basic Local Governments: "The Farther from Seoul, the Stronger the Support" (기초단체장들 만난 李 “서울서 멀수록 두텁게 지원”)
item.description:
Lee Meets Heads of Basic Local Governments: "The Farther from Seoul, the Stronger the Support" (기초단체장들 만난 李 “서울서 멀수록 두텁게 지원”)

President Lee Jae-myung held a luncheon meeting with mayors, county governors, and district heads at Cheong Wa Dae on the 27th and stated, "We will expand the practical authority and finances of local governments," adding, "The farther the distance from Seoul, the stronger the support we will provide." He asked the heads of basic local governments to refer to themselves as 'local governments' rather than 'local administrative bodies,' while also urging them, as they are on the front lines of people's livelihoods, to "take good care so that no one loses their life due to economic hardship." (이재명 대통령이 27일 청와대에서 시장·군수·구청장 초청 오찬 간담회를 갖고 “지방정부의 실질적 권한과 재정을 확대하겠다”며 “서울에서 거리가 멀수록 더 두텁게 지원하겠다”고 밝혔다. 기초단체장들에게는 ‘지방자치단체’가 아니라 ‘지방정부’로 스스로를 불러 달라고 하는 한편, 민생 최전선에 있는 만큼 “경제적 어려움으로 목숨을 잃는 사람이 없도록 잘 보살펴 달라”고도 했다.)

Regarding the issue of local extinction, President Lee said, "We have established a special local exemption system so that the farther from Seoul, the stronger the support can be, and based on this, we are continuously discovering new support tailored to local areas through these special exemptions." The system he referenced is the 'Local Preference Index.' It is an index that comprehensively factors in distance from Seoul, regional social and economic indicators, and population decline crisis levels, and is currently applied to seven programs, including child allowances and senior job opportunities. The government plans to significantly expand the number of programs next year, allocating more budget to regions with higher index scores. (이 대통령은 지방 소멸 문제와 관련해 “서울에서 거리가 멀수록 더 두텁게 지원될 수 있도록 지방 특례 제도를 마련했고, 또 이를 토대로 지방에 특화된 지원이 가도록 지방 특례를 통해 새롭게 계속 발굴해 나가고 있다”고 했다. 이 대통령이 언급한 제도는 ‘지방우대지수’다. 서울과의 거리, 지역별 사회·경제 지표, 인구 소멸 위기 등을 종합한 지수로 현재 아동수당, 노인 일자리 등 7개 사업에 적용되고 있다. 정부는 내년에는 사업 수를 대폭 확대해 지수가 높은 지역에 더 예산을 배정한다는 방침이다.)

President Lee also asked the heads to "take good care so that no one loses their life due to economic hardship." A Cheong Wa Dae official explained, "The President has always had a strong interest in the issue of suicide, and since the heads are the ones who encounter residents' lives most closely, this was a request to pay close attention to such matters." (이 대통령은 “경제적 어려움으로 목숨을 잃는 사람이 없도록 잘 보살펴 달라”고 단체장들에게 부탁하기도 했다. 청와대 관계자는 “평소 대통령이 자살 문제에 관심이 높기도 하고, 단체장들이 주민들의 삶을 가장 가까이에서 마주하는 분들인 만큼 이런 부분을 잘 챙겨 달라는 의미”라고 설명했다.)

Cho Jae-gu, chairman of the Association of Mayors, County Governors, and District Heads (and mayor of Nam-gu, Daegu), who delivered remarks on behalf of the attendees, expressed gratitude that the association chairman would begin attending State Council meetings starting in August. The government recently officially designated the chairman of the Association of Mayors, County Governors, and District Heads of the Republic of Korea as a participant in State Council meetings. (참석자를 대표해 인사한 조재구 시장·군수·구청장협의회장(대구 남구청장)이 8월부터 협의회장이 국무회의에 배석하게 된 점에 사의를 표했다. 정부는 최근 대한민국시장·군수·구청장협의회장을 국무회의 배석 대상으로 공식 지정했다.)

Earlier, President Lee had met with heads of metropolitan governments the previous day and stated, "Alongside the three major mega-projects, the government is also devoting full efforts to fostering next-generation strategic industries that will support locally led growth." At that meeting, Gyeonggi Province Governor Choo Mi-ae said, "The first reality I faced after taking office was the very severe fiscal crisis of Gyeonggi Province. On the surface, the budget exceeds 40 trillion won, making finances seem ample, but the actual fiscal conditions have seen deficits of 1 to 2 trillion won accumulate for years, and we are facing structural limits that cannot be overcome through our own efforts alone." (앞서 이 대통령은 전날 광역단체장들과 만나 “정부는 3대 메가 프로젝트와 함께 지방 주도 성장을 뒷받침할 차세대 전략 산업 육성에도 총력을 기울이고 있다”고 한 바 있다. 이 자리에서 추미애 경기도지사는 “도정을 맡은 이후 가장 먼저 마주한 현실은 매우 엄중한 경기도의 재정 위기였다”며 “겉으로는 40조원을 넘는 예산 규모로 재정이 넉넉해 보이지만 실제 재정 여건은 수년째 1조~2조원 적자가 누적돼 자체적인 노력만으로는 극복하기 어려운 구조적 한계에 직면해 있다”고 했다.)

item.title: Kim Min-seok: Jung is a "no centrist" advocate; Jung Cheong-rae: "Violent insult-slinging" (김민석 “鄭 ‘중도는 없다’론자” 정청래 “폭력적 모욕주기”)
item.description:
Kim Min-seok: Jung is a "no centrist" advocate; Jung Cheong-rae: "Violent insult-slinging" (김민석 “鄭 ‘중도는 없다’론자” 정청래 “폭력적 모욕주기”)

At the first National Assembly member workshop held after Kim Min-seok took office as the leader of the Democratic Party of Korea, the "Seok-Cheong (Kim Min-seok and Jung Cheong-rae) conflict" resurfaced. In a public lecture, Representative Kim characterized former Representative Jung as a leading advocate of the "there is no centrist" stance. In response, Jung pushed back, calling it "rude and violent microphone dictatorship" and "one-sided bashing meant to insult." The conflict between factions erupted at an event meant to emphasize "one team" as President Lee's approval rating has plunged to the 30 percent range. (김민석 더불어민주당 대표 취임 후 처음 열린 국회의원 워크숍에서 ‘석청(김민석·정청래) 갈등’이 다시 불거졌다. 김 대표는 공개 강연에서 정 전 대표를 “대표적인 ‘중도는 없다’론자”로 규정했다. 이에 정 전 대표는 “무례하고 폭력적인 마이크 독재”이자 “모욕주기식 일방적 난타”라고 반발했다. 이 대통령 지지율이 30%대까지 추락하며 ‘원팀’을 강조하려고 마련한 자리에서 계파 갈등이 표출된 것이다.)

The Democratic Party held a two-day workshop in Incheon starting on the 27th. The event began on a warm note, with Representative Kim personally presenting flowers and a plaque of appreciation to former Representative Jung, who was the previous party leader. The plaque read: "You served as party leader with dedication and led the way for the development of the Democratic Party with all your heart and effort." (민주당은 27일 1박2일 일정으로 인천에서 워크숍을 개최했다. 이날 행사는 김 대표가 전임 대표였던 정 전 대표에게 직접 꽃다발과 감사패를 전달하며 훈훈하게 시작됐다. 감사패에는 ‘당 대표직을 수행하며 열과 성을 다해 민주당의 발전을 위해 앞장서 주셨다’는 글귀가 적혀 있었다.)

Afterward, Representative Kim gave a 20-minute lecture under the theme "The Golden Age of Democracy," during which he revealed conversations he had with former Representative Jung. The content concerned their differences in political direction. Kim said, "Former Representative Jung is a leading advocate of the 'there is no centrist' stance" and "takes the position that unity is ultimately the path to victory." He added, "In contrast, I believe—and I think the President likely shares a similar view—that expansion toward the moderate conservative spectrum is necessary." Kim emphasized, "The livelihood, pragmatism, and expansion line is the line of our government, and it is the party line chosen by an overwhelming number of party members at the August 17 party convention." He also noted, "I have reached a tentative conclusion that it is difficult to find a compromise (with Jung)." (이후 김 대표는 ‘민주의 황금시대’를 주제로 20분간 강연하며 정 전 대표와 나눈 대화를 공개했다. 노선 차이를 느꼈다는 내용이었다. 김 대표는 “정 전 대표님은 대표적인 ‘중도는 없다’론자”라며 “단결하는 것이 결국 승리하는 길이라고 보는 입장”이라고 했다. 이어 “그에 반해 저는, 아마 대통령도 비슷한 생각일 것이라고 보는데, 중도 보수의 확장이 필요하다고 보는 의견”이라고 했다. 김 대표는 “민생·실용·확장 노선이 우리 정부의 노선이고 이번 8·17 전당대회에서 압도적 당원들이 선택한 당의 노선”이라고 강조했다. 그러면서 “(정 전 대표와) 절충하기가 좀 어렵다는 잠정적 결론을 내렸다”고도 했다.)

Representative Kim holds the position that only through the "structural majority" advocated by President Lee Jae-myung—embracing moderates and conservatives alike—can the party achieve "consecutive governance." However, former Representative Jung and figures like Yoo Si-min argue that rallying the Democratic Party's traditional support base is the key to "regime re-creation." On that day, Kim also criticized Yoo Si-min's "ABC theory," which divides Democratic Party supporters into three categories. Yoo had predicted that B, referring to "New Lee Jae-myung," would be the first to turn away from the current administration. In response, Kim said, "I don't think that's particularly accurate." (김 대표는 이재명 대통령이 주장해온 ‘구조적 다수’를 통해 중도·보수까지 껴안는 대통합을 해야만 ‘연속 집권’이 가능하다는 입장이다. 하지만 정 전 대표와 유시민씨 등은 민주당 전통 지지층을 결집시켜야만 ‘정권 재창출’을 할 수 있다는 쪽이다. 김 대표는 이날 유시민씨가 민주당 지지층을 세 가지로 나눈 ‘ABC론’도 비판했다. 유씨는 이 중 ‘뉴이재명’을 뜻하는 B가 가장 먼저 현 정권에 등을 돌릴 것이라고 전망한 바 있다. 이에 대해 김 대표는 “별로 맞다고 생각하지 않는다”고 했다.)

In response, former Representative Jung expressed displeasure and left the workshop midway. He later wrote on Facebook, targeting Kim, "I express regret over the use of my real name as a tool for your argumentation" and called the "one-sided assertions made by name, cutting off all context, almost violent." Pro-Jung lawmakers also joined in. Supreme Council member Lee Seong-yun wrote on Facebook, "Is it appropriate to publicly insult a former party leader and rival in the party convention?" adding, "The theory of expanding toward moderate pragmatism is not an absolute truth either." Lawmaker Moon Jeong-bok also told reporters, "Did he have to drag out a one- or two-minute conversation and unilaterally bring it up? It was inappropriate." (그러자 정 전 대표는 불쾌감을 드러내며 워크숍 도중 자리를 떠났다. 이후 페이스북에 김 대표를 향해 “제 실명을 거론하며 자신의 논리 전개 도구로 사용한 것에 유감을 표한다”며 “거두절미 앞뒤 자르고 실명을 거명하며 일방적으로 주장한 것은 거의 폭력적”이라고 썼다. 친청계 의원들도 가세했다. 이성윤 최고위원은 페이스북에 “전당대회 경쟁자이자 이전 당대표를 공개모욕을 주는 것이 과연 맞냐”며 “중도 실용 외연 확장론도 절대 진리는 아닐 것“이라고 했다. 문정복 의원도 기자들과 만나 “굳이 그분하고 얘기했던 1~2분의 대화를 끌어다가 일방적으로 얘기를 했어야 되느냐. 적절하지 않았다”고 했다.)

As controversy grew, Representative Kim posted on X (formerly Twitter), saying, "If I caused discomfort, I ask for your understanding." A key party official said, "With the President's approval rating in the '30s' and the Blue House issuing an official statement vowing to do its best, we held the workshop for the sake of unity—but all that remains is the Seok-Cheong conflict." (논란이 되자 김 대표는 엑스(X)에 글을 올려 “불편을 드렸다면 이해를 구한다”고 했다. 민주당 핵심 관계자는 “대통령 지지율이 ‘30%대’가 나오고 청와대가 최선을 다하겠다는 공식 입장까지 낸 상황에서 화합 차원의 워크숍을 열었는데, 석청 갈등만 남았다”고 했다.)

At the closed-door workshop that day, analysis and discussions regarding the decline in the President's approval rating reportedly continued. It was also revealed that an internal poll showed 59.3 percent of supporters in the capital region might withdraw their support due to real estate issues. Data also showed that 32.7 percent of Democratic Party supporters from the last presidential election had weakened in their support, and 70.3 percent of those in their 20s and 30s said "the Democratic Party does not understand us." In the National Barometer Survey (NBS) released that day, President Lee's approval rating stood at 50 percent, down 19 percentage points in four months. Additionally, 63 percent agreed with the claim that President Lee should state he would not run in the next presidential election if the constitution is amended. (이날 비공개 워크숍에선 대통령 지지율 하락과 관련한 분석과 논의가 이어졌다고 한다. 수도권 지지자의 59.3%가 부동산 문제로 지지를 철회할 가능성이 있다는 자체 여론조사 결과도 공개된 것으로 알려졌다. 지난 대선 민주당 지지자의 32.7%는 지지세가 약화됐고, 2030세대의 70.3%는 “민주당이 우리를 이해하지 못한다”는 내용도 나왔다. 이날 전국지표조사(NBS)에선 이 대통령 국정 지지율은 50%로 4개월 만에 19%포인트 하락했다. 이 대통령이 개헌 시 차기 대선에 출마하지 않겠다는 입장을 밝혀야 한다는 주장에는 63%가 동의했다.)

Amid this situation, the Blue House also canceled a luncheon scheduled for the 28th between President Lee Jae-myung and all Democratic Party lawmakers. A ruling camp official said, "It's due to the Nepal flood situation, but the approval rating likely had an influence as well." (이런 가운데 청와대는 28일 예정됐던 이재명 대통령과 민주당 의원 전체 오찬도 취소했다. 여권 관계자는 “네팔 홍수 사태 때문이지만 지지율도 영향을 미치지 않았겠느냐”고 했다.)

item.title: Park Geun-hye attends People Power Party workshop for first time in 14 years (14년 만에 국힘 연찬회 간 박근혜)
item.description:
Park Geun-hye attends People Power Party workshop for first time in 14 years (14년 만에 국힘 연찬회 간 박근혜)

The People Power Party (PPP) held a legislative workshop on the 27th to discuss response strategies for the regular session of the National Assembly in September. The party leadership invited former President Park Geun-hye, sending a message to "unite in the fight against the opposition." However, some lawmakers in attendance said, "There was no discussion of specific reform visions or innovation plans for the next general election." (국민의힘은 27일 국회의원 연찬회를 열고 9월 정기 국회 대응 전략 등을 논의했다. 당 지도부는 박근혜 전 대통령을 초청해 “대여 투쟁으로 뭉치자”는 메시지를 냈다. 하지만 참석한 일부 의원은 “다음 총선을 위한 구체적 개혁 비전이나 혁신 방안에 대한 토론은 없었다”고 했다.)

Party leader Jang Dong-hyuk said in his speech at the workshop held at Sono Calm Hotel in Goyang, Gyeonggi Province, that day: "We must thoroughly expose the misgovernment and tyranny of the Lee Jae-myung regime and present our party's proper alternatives," adding, "Let us resist and block it together with the people." Floor leader Jeong Jeom-sik said, "The past year of the Lee Jae-myung government has been a year of destruction and dismantlement," and "We must point out, item by item, what went wrong in each standing committee and offer alternatives." (장동혁 대표는 이날 경기 고양 소노캄 호텔에서 열린 의원 연찬회 연설에서 “이재명 정권의 실정과 폭정을 낱낱이 파헤치고, 우리 당의 올바른 대안을 제시해야 한다”며 “국민과 함께 저항하고 막아내자”고 했다. 정점식 원내대표는 “이재명 정부의 지난 1년은 파괴와 해체의 1년이었다”며 “각 상임위에서 무엇이 잘못됐는지 조목조목 지적하고 대안을 제시해야 한다”고 했다.)

Afterward, special lectures followed on topics such as artificial intelligence (AI), diplomatic security, and conflict resolution. One first-term lawmaker said, "It wasn't a lecture on party innovation, nor was it an atmosphere conducive to open discussion." According to the PPP, 101 of the 109 lawmakers attended the event. Among those recently disciplined with suspension of party membership by the party's ethics committee, lawmakers Kwon Young-jin, Seo Beom-su, and Jin Jong-oh, excluding Cho Kyoung-tae, did not attend. (이후 인공지능(AI), 외교 안보, 갈등 해소를 주제로 한 특강이 이어졌다. 한 초선 의원은 “당 혁신과 관련한 강연을 들은 것도 아니고, 자유 토론이 이뤄지는 분위기도 아니었다”고 했다. 국민의힘에 따르면 이날 행사엔 의원 109명 중 101명이 참석했다. 최근 당 윤리위원회에서 당원권 정지 징계를 받은 사람 가운데 조경태 의원을 제외한 권영진·서범수·진종오 의원 등은 불참했다.)

Former President Park Geun-hye also attended the workshop that day. Park was expelled from the Liberty Korea Party (the PPP's predecessor) in 2017 over the "national power abuse" scandal and holds no party membership, but she campaigned for PPP candidates during the last local elections. On this day, she also took the stage to speak at the request of Floor Leader Jeong Jeom-sik. It was her first time joining lawmakers at a workshop since attending one for the Saenuri Party (formerly the PPP) in 2012 when she was a presidential candidate, marking 14 years. (이날 연찬회에는 박근혜 전 대통령도 참석했다. 박 전 대통령은 ‘국정 농단’ 사건으로 2017년 자유한국당(국민의힘 전신)에서 출당돼 당적이 없지만 지난 지방선거 때 국민의힘 후보 지원 유세를 했다. 이날도 정점식 원내대표 요청에 따라 연설에 나섰다. 박 전 대통령은 대선 후보였던 2012년 새누리당(옛 국민의힘) 의원 연찬회에 참석한 후 14년 만에 의원들과 함께했다.)

Former President Park said, "Within a political party, various opinions may emerge, but we must not hate or deny one another," and "In difficult times, we must unite in solidarity around the leadership and move forward." She also emphasized "Mushin bulnip (no standing without trust)," stating, "If there is no trust within a party, that party cannot survive." She then compared the struggles of a minority opposition party to "the process of a caterpillar becoming a butterfly," adding, "A time of desperate struggle is needed." As she concluded her speech, Park asked, "Can I trust you and move forward?" and lawmakers responded with a standing ovation. (박 전 대통령은 “정당 내에서 다양한 의견이 나올 수 있지만 서로를 증오하고 부정해서는 안 된다”며 “어려운 때일수록 지도부를 중심으로 일치단결해서 나아가야 한다”고 했다. 또 “정당 내에서 신의가 없으면 그 정당은 존립할 수 없다”며 ‘무신불립(無信不立·신뢰 없이 설 수 없다)’을 강조했다. 이어 소수 야당의 어려움을 “애벌레가 나비가 되는 과정”에 비유하며 “처절한 발버둥의 시간이 필요하다”고 했다. 박 전 대통령은 연설을 마무리하며 “제가 여러분을 믿고 가도 되겠느냐”고 물었고, 의원들은 기립 박수를 보냈다.)

A PPP official said, "Since the party has been repeating internal strife, former President Park seems to have emphasized 'unity over division.'" Some within the party interpret that the move may reflect the intentions of mainstream lawmakers seeking to create a focal point around Park. After Park's speech, Chairman Jang told reporters, "If we look in different directions or pick fights internally, that is not trust, in my view." (국민의힘 관계자는 “당이 내분을 반복하고 있으니 박 전 대통령이 ‘분열보다 단합’을 강조한 것 같다”고 했다. 당 일각에선 박 전 대통령을 중심으로 구심점을 만들어보자는 구주류 의원들의 의중이 반영된 것 아니겠느냐는 해석도 나온다. 장 대표는 박 전 대통령 연설 후 기자들과 만나 “다른 방향을 보고 가거나, 우리 내부를 향해서 싸움을 건다면 신의는 아니라고 생각한다”고 했다.)

That day, some lawmakers also reacted that "inviting an impeached president at a time when we should be talking about party innovation was inappropriate." One three-term lawmaker said, "It's regrettable that our party seems to be returning to the past rather than the future." A two-term lawmaker expressed concern, saying, "I worry the public will see us as 'an opposition party with no will to reform.'" (이날 일부 의원은 “당의 혁신을 말해야 할 시점에 탄핵당한 대통령을 부른 것은 적절치 않았다”는 반응도 보였다. 한 3선 의원은 “우리 당이 미래가 아닌 과거로 회귀하는 것 같아 아쉽다”고 했다. 한 재선 의원은 “국민에게 ‘쇄신 의지가 없는 야당’으로 비칠까 걱정”이라고 했다.)

item.title: U.S. Military Inundated with Protests over Release of Anti-Communist POWs... Rhee Syngman's One Line That Protected Baek Seon-yeop (반공 포로 석방에 미군 항의 빗발… 백선엽을 지킨 이승만의 한 마디)
item.description:
U.S. Military Inundated with Protests over Release of Anti-Communist POWs... Rhee Syngman's One Line That Protected Baek Seon-yeop (반공 포로 석방에 미군 항의 빗발… 백선엽을 지킨 이승만의 한 마디)

The "surprise release of anti-communist prisoners of war" that stunned the world in an instant was carried out with remarkable boldness and speed. Baek Seon-yeop was not oblivious to such a move, but he was in a position where it was difficult to intervene rashly. The president had his own duties as president, and as the Chief of Staff of the Republic of Korea Army leading the military, the Chief of Staff had his own distinct role. (세계를 일거에 경악하게 한 ‘반공 포로 전격 석방’은 그야말로 대담하며 신속하게 이뤄졌다. 백선엽은 그런 움직임에 둔감하지 않았으나, 함부로 개입하기도 어려운 입장이었다. 대통령은 대통령으로서 할 일이 있었고, 군을 이끄는 한국 육군참모총장으로서는 총장의 역할이 따로 있었다.)

President Rhee Syngman was a strong and towering figure who never yielded an inch in the game of brinkmanship with the United States. Rather, he was fully revealing his fierce side as a gambler who could overturn the entire board against the mighty America. His bluster about "the ROK military's unilateral advance north and unification" often threw the United States into deep embarrassment. Baek Seon-yeop was in a position where he had to follow the president's assertions, but he could not step forward recklessly either. (이승만 대통령은 미국과의 기세 싸움에서 전혀 밀리지 않는 강인하고 거대한 인물이었다. 아니, 어쩌면 강대한 미국을 상대로 판을 한꺼번에 뒤집어 버리는 승부사로서 맹렬한 면모를 다 드러내고 있었다. 그가 주장하는 ‘한국군 단독 북진과 통일’이라는 으름장은 그런 미국을 자주 곤혹감에 몰아넣기도 했다. 백선엽은 그런 대통령의 주장을 따라야 하는 입장이었으나, 함부로 나설 수도 없었다.)

At the time, it was wartime. The war on the Korean Peninsula at that time could not escape American influence. The person forming the sharpest point of contact in negotiations with the U.S. military was none other than Baek Seon-yeop. The U.S. command had established its closest cooperative relationship with Baek Seon-yeop, the Korean commander they had trusted and relied on since the outbreak of the Korean War, and Baek Seon-yeop happened to hold the position of Chief of Staff of the ROK Army at that very moment. (당시는 전시(戰時)였다. 한반도의 그때 전쟁은 미국의 영향력을 벗어날 수 없었다. 그런 미군과의 교섭에 가장 첨예한 접점을 형성하고 있던 인물이 바로 백선엽이었다. 미군 지휘부는 6·25전쟁 발발 후 믿고 의지했던 백선엽이라는 한국 지휘관과 가장 두터운 협력 관계를 맺은 상태였고, 백선엽은 마침 그 시점에 대한민국 육군참모총장이라는 자리에 있었다.)

Therefore, Baek Seon-yeop was absolutely bound to obey the orders of the president as commander-in-chief, yet he could not arbitrarily step outside the framework of negotiating with and maintaining cooperation with the U.S. military. President Rhee was well aware of this, and accordingly, he excluded Baek Seon-yeop from the "release of anti-communist POWs" that would greatly provoke the United States. (따라서 백선엽은 통수권자인 대통령의 명령에는 절대적으로 따라야 하지만, 미군과의 교섭과 협력 유지라는 틀을 함부로 벗어날 수 없었다. 이 대통령도 그 점을 잘 알았고, 그에 따라 미국을 크게 자극할 ‘반공 포로 석방’에서 백선엽을 제외했던 것이다.)

The event unfolded on the evening of June 18. As introduced earlier, President Rhee Syngman had established the "Provost Marshal General's Headquarters" commanded by General Won Yong-deok, and once darkness fell on the 18th, personnel from the headquarters went around the POW camps, cutting electric wires and barbed wire to help anti-communist prisoners escape. They also meticulously guided them by preparing civilian clothes to change into at various government offices after the escape. (6월 18일 저녁에 일은 벌어지고 말았다. 앞서 소개한 대로 이승만 대통령은 원용덕 장군이 지휘하는 ‘헌병 총사령부’를 만들었고, 18일 어둠이 깔리자 총사령부의 인원들은 포로 수용소를 돌며 전기선과 철조망을 끊어 반공 포로들이 탈출할 수 있도록 도왔다. 각급 관공서에는 탈출 뒤 갈아입을 복장 등을 준비해 치밀하게 그들을 이끌기도 했다.)

It was a shocking measure that could have undone all the progress of the armistice talks that had continued up to that point. The voices of "astonishment" that learned of the news only later came immediately. Phone calls from the top U.S. military leadership rang directly at the official residence of Chief of Staff Baek Seon-yeop at the Daegu Army Headquarters. (그때까지 이어지던 휴전회담의 모든 성과가 수포로 돌아갈 수도 있는 충격적인 조치였다. 그 소식을 나중에야 안 ‘경악’의 목소리는 바로 전해졌다. 미군 수뇌부에서 걸려온 전화가 대구 육군본부 백선엽 참모총장 관사에 바로 울렸다.)

The first to call was Major General Ryan, commander of the U.S. Military Advisory Group stationed in Korea supporting the Korean military. Then the phone rang again, it was said. It was a call from Maxwell Taylor, commander of the U.S. Eighth Army. The third call came from Mark Clark, commander-in-chief of the United Nations Command in Tokyo. (가장 먼저 전화를 건 사람은 한국에 주둔하며 한국군을 지원하던 미 군사고문단장 라이언 소장이었다. 바로 이어서 전화가 또 울렸다고 했다. 맥스웰 테일러 미8군 사령관의 전화였다. 세 번째 전화는 마크 클라크 도쿄 주재 유엔군 총사령관에게서 걸려왔다.)

General Baek Seon-yeop recalled in his memoirs: "The phone kept ringing at dawn. All the calls were from the top U.S. military leadership, and every one of them, shocked, was demanding to know the details of what had happened." According to his recollections, all three men showed extreme agitation, asking, "General Baek, what on earth has happened?" (백선엽 장군은 생전 회고에서 “새벽에 전화기가 계속 울렸다. 모두 미군 수뇌부의 전화였고, 한결같이 놀라서 사건의 경위부터 따져 묻는 내용이었다”고 술회했다. 그의 회고에 따르면 세 사람 모두는 “백 장군, 도대체 어떻게 된 일이냐”면서 극도의 흥분 상태를 보였다고 했다.)

General Baek Seon-yeop reportedly felt deeply troubled while taking the calls. This was because the responsibility for the situation fell first and foremost on himself, as the one commanding the ROK military. If that became clear, the U.S. military's sense of betrayal would be directed at Baek Seon-yeop. The top U.S. commanders, caught in confusion, first asked about the circumstances, but in the future, they could raise disagreements over the overall support for the ROK military. It was a weighty and grave matter of great consequence. (백선엽 장군은 전화를 받으면서 곤혹감에 휩싸였다고 한다. 이 사태의 책임은 한국군을 통솔하는 자신에게 우선 있었기 때문이었다. 그 점이 확실해진다면, 미군의 배신감은 백선엽에게 쏠릴 참이었다. 미군 최고 지휘관들은 당혹감에 빠져 우선 사태의 경위를 물었지만 향후 그들은 한국군 지원 전반에 관해 이견을 제기할 수도 있었다. 무겁고 큰 중차대(重且大)의 사안이었다.)

President Rhee Syngman, through the Provost Marshal General's Headquarters, released approximately 25,000 anti-communist POWs in the first wave, and an additional 2,000 reportedly escaped the camps. From the perspectives of the UN side and the communist side, the sharply contested issue of anti-communist prisoners had suddenly tipped entirely toward "release," which was nothing short of what is commonly called a "catastrophe." World media reportedly covered the news extensively. The content, which could turn the armistice into nothing, was transmitted urgently around the globe, then coalesced into the fury and protests of the U.S. military command, aimed back at the ROK military and government. (이승만 대통령이 헌병 총사령부를 시켜 1차로 석방한 반공 포로는 2만5000명 정도였고, 추가로 2000명이 수용소를 빠져나왔다고 했다. 유엔 측과 공산 측의 입장에서 볼 때 첨예하게 대립했던 반공 성향의 포로 문제가 일거에 ‘석방’으로 기울고 말았으니 흔히 이야기하는 ‘파국(破局)’에 다름 아니었다. 세계의 언론들은 이 뉴스를 대대적으로 보도했다고 한다. 휴전이 물거품으로 변할지도 모를 이 내용은 긴급 타전 형식으로 세계 곳곳에 전해진 뒤 미군 지휘부의 분노와 항의로 뭉쳐져 다시 한국군과 정부를 향하고 있었다.)

Baek Seon-yeop could not remain silent in the face of the fury and protests of the top U.S. military leadership. Nor could he feign ignorance by saying, "The president did it, I know nothing." That was something he, as Chief of Staff leading the ROK military, could not say. Such an evasive, improvised answer to shirk responsibility was also not in keeping with Baek Seon-yeop's character. He reportedly fell into deep thought after receiving the calls that bordered on rebukes from the highest-ranking U.S. generals. (백선엽은 미군 수뇌부의 분노와 항의에 침묵만 할 수 없었다. 그렇다고 “대통령이 한 일이라 나는 모른다”고 잡아뗄 수도 없었다. 한국군을 이끄는 참모총장으로서는 해서는 안 될 말이었다. 책임을 회피하려는 그런 임기응변의 답변은 백선엽의 성향(性向)과도 맞지 않았다. 그는 미군 최고위 장성들의 힐난과도 같은 전화를 받고 생각에 잠겼다고 했다.)

President Rhee Syngman must have clearly anticipated that such a situation would arise, Baek Seon-yeop thought. He first wanted to ascertain the president's intentions, and if the case required him to step forward, then he thought he should do so. He reportedly called the temporary presidential residence, Gyeongmudae. But it was dawn. The secretary on duty only repeated, "I cannot wake the president." (이승만 대통령 또한 이런 상황이 닥칠지를 분명히 생각했을 것이라고 봤다. 그는 우선 대통령의 의중이 어떤지를 묻고, 전면에 스스로 나서야 하는 경우라면 그래야 한다고 생각했다. 그는 임시 경무대로 전화를 걸었다고 했다. 그러나 새벽이었다. 당직이었던 비서관은 “대통령을 깨울 수 없다”는 말만 반복했다.)

Baek Seon-yeop recounted that he called three times but received the same answer each time. The attitude of the Gyeongmudae secretaries, who were unaware of the gravity of the situation, was consistent. On the final call, Baek Seon-yeop apparently raised his voice. He said, "A major crisis has befallen the Republic of Korea, and if you do not wake His Excellency now, something truly unbearable will happen." Only then did the secretary seem to go to wake the president, it is said. (백선엽은 세 번 전화를 걸었으나 모두 같은 답변만 들었다고 술회했다. 사태의 심각성을 잘 모르는 경무대 비서관들 태도는 한결같았다. 마지막 통화에서 백선엽은 소리를 높였던 모양이다. “대한민국에 이런 큰일이 벌어졌는데, 각하를 지금 깨우지 않으면 정말 감당하기 어려운 일이 벌어진다”고 했다. 그제야 비서관은 대통령을 깨우는 눈치였다고 한다.)

After some time, the president picked up the receiver. Baek Seon-yeop explained the contents of the calls from the U.S. military leadership. In response, President Rhee Syngman answered in a low voice. Baek Seon-yeop recalled that he said, "Yes, I understand. Tell them I did it all. I will issue a press release tomorrow," and then hung up. (조금 시간이 지나자 대통령이 수화기를 들었다. 백선엽은 미군 수뇌부의 전화 내용을 설명했다. 그러자 이승만 대통령은 나지막한 목소리로 이렇게 대답했다. “그래, 알았네. 모두 내가 한 일이라고 해. 내일 프레스 릴리스(press release 언론 보도) 하겠네”라고 말하면서 전화를 끊었다고 백선엽은 회고했다.)

Regarding that incident, which was like a "nuclear bomb" capable of overturning the armistice itself, Washington reportedly plunged into extreme agitation almost immediately. At a Washington meeting presided over by President Eisenhower, remarks even reportedly went as far as discussing the implementation of emergency plans in preparation for a contingency in Korea. (휴전 자체를 뒤집어엎을 만한 ‘핵 폭탄’과도 같았던 그 사태를 두고 워싱턴은 곧바로 극도의 흥분에 빠졌던 모양이다. 아이젠하워 대통령이 주재하는 워싱턴 회의에서는 급기야 한국 유사시에 대비하는 비상 계획 실행을 검토하라는 발언까지 나왔다고 전해진다.)

President Rhee Syngman could have been forced to step down from power due to the strong emergency measures of the U.S. military. But President Rhee was strong. The communist side did not reject the armistice talks altogether over the release of anti-communist prisoners. It was a decisive victory for President Rhee Syngman, who understood the essence of communism, over the United States. Even in the midst of it all, President Rhee kept negotiations and cooperation with the U.S. military in mind, and by saying "Tell them I did it," he shielded and protected Baek Seon-yeop, the linchpin of that role, by keeping him out of the fray. <<>> (이승만 대통령은 미군의 강력한 비상 조치로 인해 강제로 하야(下野)할 수도 있었다. 그러나 이승만 대통령은 강했다. 공산 측이 반공 포로 석방으로 인해 휴전회담 자체를 거부하지 않았던 것이다. 공산주의의 본질을 꿰뚫어 본 이승만 대통령이 미국을 상대로 압승을 거둔 셈이었다. 그 와중에도 이 대통령은 미군과의 교섭과 협력을 염두에 뒀고, 그 역할의 중추였던 백선엽을 “내가 했다고 하게”라며 뒤로 빼 보호했던 것이다.)

item.title: As Lee's approval rating drops to 30s, Kim Eo-jun says "We need to review what caused the decline" (李지지율 30%대에 김어준 “하락 원인 복기해 봐야 할 것”)
item.description:
As Lee's approval rating drops to 30s, Kim Eo-jun says "We need to review what caused the decline" (李지지율 30%대에 김어준 “하락 원인 복기해 봐야 할 것”)

As some polls showed President Lee Jae-myung's national approval rating falling, Kim Eo-jun has followed Yoo Si-min in issuing a public warning. These figures, who hold influence over the traditional pro-government support base, have criticized the president's drive to expand his appeal and called for a change in direction. (일부 여론조사에서 이재명 대통령의 국정 지지율이 하락하자 유시민씨에 이어 김어준씨도 공개 경고하고 나섰다. 전통적 여권 지지층에 영향력이 있는 이들은 이 대통령이 추진하는 외연 확장 노선을 비판하면서 기조를 바꾸라고 했다.)

On the 27th, Kim Eo-jun said on his YouTube channel regarding the decline in the president's approval rating, "This is a kind of ordeal unprecedented in President Lee's political life," adding, "We cannot help but review why this happened." Kim referred to reports that on the 25th, the president said at a dinner with the Democratic Party's new leadership that he "didn't take enough care of the left (core support base)." He commented, "If the (supporters') hearts turn away, even a single remark like that can be enough for them to berate and disparage (the president) all day long." He also said regarding Yoo Si-min's recent harsh criticism of the president on YouTube, using expressions such as "the image of an arrogant power-holder" and "monarchical rule," that "I fully understand why he has come out to criticize." (김어준씨는 27일 본인 유튜브에서 이 대통령 지지율 하락에 대해 “이 대통령 정치 인생에 처음 있는 종류의 시련”이라며 “왜 이런 일이 일어났는지 복기하지 않을 수 없다”고 했다. 김씨는 지난 25일 이 대통령이 민주당 신임 지도부 만찬에서 “왼쪽(핵심 지지층)을 너무 챙기지 않았다”는 취지로 말했다는 보도를 언급하며 “(지지층의) 마음이 떠나면, 그 표현 하나로도 하루 종일 (이 대통령을) 타박하고 평가절하할 수 있다”고 했다. 또 유시민씨가 최근 유튜브에서 이 대통령을 향해 ‘오만한 권력자의 모습’ ‘왕정’ 등의 표현으로 강도 높은 비판을 한 데 대해서도 “왜 나서서 비판하는지 저는 충분히 이해한다”고도 했다.)

Yoo and Kim have argued that the recent drop in the president's approval rating is because the Democratic Party's traditional support base has turned its back, and they have clashed with the president, who has emphasized pragmatism and broadening his appeal. Pro-Lee factions within the party are pushing back strongly. (유씨와 김씨는 최근 이 대통령 지지율 하락이 민주당 전통 지지층이 등을 돌렸기 때문이라며 실용과 외연 확장을 강조해 온 이 대통령과 각을 세워왔다. 민주당 내 친명계는 강하게 반발하고 있다.)

Regarding Kim Eo-jun's remarks on the 24th on YouTube, where he said, "The only case of the president's approval rating falling to the mid-30s and then rebounding is during the Moon Jae-in administration," lawmaker Lee Hae-sik wrote on Facebook that day, "That's a lie. Under the Kim Young-sam, Kim Dae-jung, and Park Geun-hye administrations, approval ratings (that had fallen below 30%) also rebounded," adding, "Let's join forces together." (이해식 의원은 김어준씨가 지난 24일 유튜브에서 “대통령 지지율이 30% 중반대로 떨어졌다 반등한 건 문재인 정부 사례가 유일하다”는 취지로 발언한 데 대해 이날 페이스북 글에서 “거짓말이다. 김영삼·김대중·박근혜 정부 때도 (30% 아래로 떨어졌던 지지율이) 반등했다”며 “우리 함께 힘을 모으자”고 했다.)

Supreme Council member Park Sun-won said in a radio interview that day about Yoo Si-min's criticism of the president, "It seems like he poured out emotion rather than commentary," calling "(Yoo's remarks) nonsensical and false." Lawmaker Chung Jin-wook recently referred to Yoo as "a shaman, not a writer" as well. Earlier, lawmaker Park Hong-keun also criticized Yoo, saying it was "spitting into the well we dug together." (박선원 최고위원은 이날 라디오 인터뷰에서 유시민씨가 대통령을 비판한 데 대해 “평론이 아닌 감정을 쏟아낸 것 같다”며 “(유씨 발언은) 어불성설이고 허위 사실”이라고 했다. 정진욱 의원은 유씨에 대해 최근 “작가가 아닌 무당”이라고도 했다. 앞서 박홍근 의원도 유씨에 대해 “함께 판 우물에 침 뱉는 행위”라고 비판했다.)

However, even within the pro-Lee faction, there is a sense of frustration as no suitable card is visible to reverse the decline in the president's approval rating. One Democratic Party lawmaker said, "Given that the support base's approval rating is falling in a troubling way, it's hard to simply dismiss the harsh words from outside as 'internal infighting.'" (하지만 친명계 내에서도 이 대통령 지지율 하락세를 반등시킬 마땅한 카드가 보이지 않아 난감해하는 분위기다. 민주당의 한 의원은 “외곽의 쓴소리를 ‘내부 총질’로만 치부하기엔 지지층의 지지율 하락이 심상치 않다”고 했다.)

item.title: Instead of Dropping the Indictment, Exemption for Daejang-dong? Blue House Leans Toward ‘Special Act After Abolishing Breach of Duty’ (공소 취소 대신 대장동 면소? 靑 ‘배임죄 없앤 뒤 특례법’ 가닥)
item.description:
Instead of Dropping the Indictment, Exemption for Daejang-dong? Blue House Leans Toward ‘Special Act After Abolishing Breach of Duty’ (공소 취소 대신 대장동 면소? 靑 ‘배임죄 없앤 뒤 특례법’ 가닥)

The Blue House has reportedly decided to move toward abolishing the current crime of breach of duty and enacting a special law to replace it, picking up the pace as of the 27th. This reportedly reflects the judgment that legal revisions are needed ahead of large-scale semiconductor company investment in the government’s ‘three major mega projects.’ However, some in political circles are saying about the speed behind the abolition of the breach of duty crime, “Isn’t it because of the Daejang-dong case trial, where President Lee Jae-myung was indicted on breach of duty charges?” If the crime of breach of duty disappears, President Lee is highly likely to receive an ‘exemption from prosecution (免訴)’ ruling on his breach of duty charges. <<> A government official said, “The abolition of the breach of duty crime was originally deliberated by the Ministry of Justice, the lead ministry, weighing two options: maintaining the current breach of duty crime but supplementing it to prevent excessive application, or abolishing the crime and creating a new replacement law,” adding, “In this situation, the Blue House has effectively set the direction toward abolition.” The Blue House has reportedly recently instructed the Ministry of Justice to actively consider ‘abolition’ rather than ‘retention’ of the breach of duty crime. <<> Within the ruling camp, the ‘Honam semiconductor’ initiative and other three major mega projects recently promoted by the government were also cited as reasons for the need to abolish the breach of duty crime, according to reports. A key ruling camp figure said, “If Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix’s Honam semiconductor investment later gets politically investigated as breach of duty after a possible change in administration, that would be a problem,” adding, “To eliminate such a possibility, the breach of duty crime must be abolished.” However, the Blue House side said regarding the abolition, “No final plan has been confirmed yet,” and that it is “reviewing various measures to reduce the harms of applying the breach of duty crime.” <<> Initially, the abolition of the breach of duty crime was driven after the Lee Jae-myung administration took office, with President Lee Jae-myung expressing his will and the ruling party leading the effort. In July of last year, President Lee ordered institutional improvements at an emergency economic task force meeting, saying, “The abuse of the breach of duty crime is shrinking corporate activity.” In September of last year, the government and ruling party held a party-government consultation and publicly announced their push to abolish the breach of duty crime. President Lee reportedly also ordered a ‘speed push’ for abolition when meeting with Democratic Party lawmakers in January of this year. <<> However, progress stalled due to overlapping political schedules such as local elections and concerns about public backlash if the abolition proceeded. On the 5th, then-Minister of Justice Jung Sung-ho said at a pre-briefing for the presidential work report that whether to abolish the breach of duty crime had not yet been decided, stating, “We have analyzed about 3,500 breach of duty precedents over the past five years and are in the final stage of gathering academic opinions.” He only added, “We are also discussing with Blue House aides, so improvements will come soon.” <<> The discussion on the breach of duty crime is known to have remained at a standstill because concerns poured in from the legal community, academia, and civil society regarding its abolition. Additionally, within the Ministry of Justice, which prepares government legislation, the opinion favoring ‘retention’ rather than ‘abolition’ reportedly prevailed. A Ministry of Justice official said, “There was a need for improvement because the existing breach of duty crime has been criticized as ‘whatever you want it to be,’ being applied arbitrarily in corporate investigations, with not a few cases ending in acquittals years later in court,” adding, “But since abolishing the crime would create a ‘legal vacuum’ where punishment becomes difficult, prosecutors more strongly favored clarifying the elements of the existing law to minimize side effects.” <<> In particular, it was reported that even some within the ruling camp expressed concerns, saying, “If we push for abolition, we’ll obviously be attacked for ‘erasing the president’s trial.’” President Lee was brought to trial in 2023 over breach of duty charges involving thousands of billions of won in the ‘Daejang-dong case.’ The first-instance trial has been suspended since President Lee took office. Legal circles believe that if the breach of duty crime is abolished, even if a replacement special law is created, President Lee is highly likely to receive an exemption from prosecution ruling in his trial. <<> Some in the opposition camp have said, “Since passing a special prosecution law for manipulated indictments to drop the charges in the president’s case has become difficult, they are seeking a detour to eliminate President Lee’s trial.” The Democratic Party pushed for a special prosecution law before the June election but put it on hold due to public backlash, and now there is a skeptical mood about pursuing the special prosecution itself amid falling presidential approval ratings. This is why they are speeding up the abolition of the breach of duty crime as a kind of alternative. However, a Blue House official said, “The president has called for reforming the breach of duty crime since before taking office,” and “The abolition of the breach of duty crime and the trial are unrelated.” (청와대가 최근 현행 배임죄를 폐지하고 이를 대체할 특례법을 제정하는 쪽으로 가닥을 잡고 속도를 내는 것으로 27일 알려졌다. 정부가 추진하는 ‘3대 메가 프로젝트’에 반도체 기업의 대규모 투자를 앞두고 관련 법 손질이 필요하다는 판단이 반영됐다고 한다. 하지만 정치권 일각에선 배임죄 폐지에 속도를 내는 배경을 두고 “이재명 대통령이 배임 혐의로 기소된 대장동 사건 재판 때문 아니겠느냐”는 말이 나온다. 배임죄가 사라지면 이 대통령의 배임 혐의가 ‘면소(免訴)’ 판결을 받을 가능성이 크기 때문이다.)
